title: Escalation Routing Rule R-004: Insurance claim rejected
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-004 -- Insurance claim rejected
TRIGGER TYPE: Data State
CONDITION: Cashless claim status updated to rejected
ROUTE TO: Insurance and TPA (Extension 1029)
QUEUE: QUEUE_INSURANCE
PRIORITY: HIGH
SLA: 2.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Requires urgent dispute filing, RFI appeal, or financial counseling. Contact Insurance TPA Desk ext. 1029.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Claim CLM-002 rejected citing clause 4.2
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Why did Star Health deny cashless approval?
source_citation: SMCH Escalation Routing Matrix -- R-004 (Insurance claim rejected) v1.0
